engines.localAi.launch.title: Turn on the local AI?
engines.localAi.launch.intro: Install the chat engine (llama.cpp) to run language models right on your machine. Nothing leaves your computer.
engines.localAi.launch.benefit.chat.text: talk to a local model as soon as the install ends, in the Chat tab.
engines.localAi.launch.benefit.updates.t: a small model reads the release notes and discussions before you update and flags possible regressions (advisory, to be checked).
engines.localAi.launch.benefit.prompts.t: the ✨ button rewrites your image, video and audio prompts.
engines.localAi.launch.benefit.local.tex: everything runs on your machine; only public pages (release notes) are read for updates.
engines.localAi.launch.withModel: Also download the recommended model (“{0}”, {1} GB)
engines.localAi.launch.models: Chat models stay downloadable at any time from the Chat model list.
engines.localAi.launch.settings.title: Offer the local AI at launch
engines.localAi.launch.settings.descript: While the chat engine is not installed, the application offers to install it at every launch.
